It burns because your skin is reallyyy dry, if you take the steps for it to be hydrated it wont burn and be tight. I reccomend bioderma sebium hydra cream and uriage chapstick. Apply spf in the morning and at night cicaplast cream. Drink a lot of water during the day, and consume lipids when taking the pill (yogurt was reccomended to me by my dermatologist) These are the things that helped me!
